columns.help: the account the key uploads to (espos upload, espos apps)
columns.label: User

columns.help: sha256 (hex) of the key; the key itself is made in the browser, shown once and never sent to the server except by the CLI when it uploads
columns.label: Key hash

columns.help: what the person called it ("Laptop", "CI"), at most 40 characters
columns.label: Name

columns.help: the key's last 4 characters, to tell keys apart on the web
columns.label: Ends with

columns.help: when the CLI last used it (epoch ms, written at most every 10 minutes); 0 = never
columns.label: Last used (epoch ms)
